documentation: Key/value backend for `mhl serve mcp --http` durable state (sessions + run checkpoints + owners), stored as one JSON object per key in an S3 bucket at `<prefix><key>.json`. Works with real Amazon S3 and any S3-compatible endpoint (MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Ceph RGW).

properties.name: endpoint
properties.documentation: S3 endpoint URL, e.g. http://localhost:9000 for MinIO. Omit for real AWS S3. Setting it implies path-style addressing.

properties.name: region
properties.documentation: AWS region for SigV4 signing. Default "us-east-1" (MinIO ignores it but it must still match what the client signs).

properties.name: prefix
properties.documentation: Key namespace inside the bucket. Default "mhl/". A trailing slash is added if missing; set "" to store at the bucket root.

properties.name: access_key_id
properties.documentation: Static access key id. Use env("AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"); the host resolves and redacts it.

properties.name: secret_access_key
properties.documentation: Static secret access key. Use env("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"); the host resolves and redacts it.

properties.name: session_token
properties.documentation: Optional STS session token for static credentials. Use env("AWS_SESSION_TOKEN").

properties.name: web_identity_token_file
properties.documentation: EKS IRSA / Pod Identity: path to the projected service-account token. Use env("AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE"). With `role_arn`, the extension calls STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity and refreshes before expiry. Ignored when static credentials are set.

properties.name: role_arn
properties.documentation: IRSA: the role to assume. Use env("AWS_ROLE_ARN"). Required together with `web_identity_token_file`.

properties.name: use_imds
properties.documentation: Fetch credentials from the EC2/EKS node instance role via IMDSv2 (169.254.169.254). Used only when no static and no web-identity credentials are set.

properties.name: force_path_style
properties.documentation: Force path-style addressing (bucket in the path, not the host). Implied true when `endpoint` is set.

properties.name: max_retries
properties.documentation: Retries for transient failures (transport errors, HTTP 429/5xx), with exponential backoff + full jitter. Default 3; 0 disables.

properties.name: log
properties.documentation: Optional path to append a JSON-lines wire trace (one line per handled message) for debugging.

methods.name: get
methods.documentation: The value at key, or null when the object is absent.

methods.name: put
methods.documentation: Store value at key as a JSON object, overwriting.

methods.name: delete
methods.documentation: Remove key. An absent key is not an error.

methods.name: list
methods.documentation: Every key with the given prefix (ListObjectsV2, paginated).
